% Phase 5A contract probe: outside-env cases preserve existing diagnostics
% and continuation only; they make no S1 support claim.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage[margin=24mm]{geometry}
\usepackage{dirtreex}
\pagestyle{empty}
\makeatletter
\newcount\ProbeErrors \newcount\ProbeFormatted \newcount\ProbeObserved
\newcount\ProbeNameEffects \newcount\ProbeCommentEffects \newcount\ProbeIconEffects
\newcount\ProbeCaptureLevel
\newdimen\ProbeOuterEm
\def\ProbeFail#1{\errmessage{PHASE5A ASSERTION FAILED: #1}}
\def\ProbeInt#1#2#3{\ifnum#1=#2\relax\else\ProbeFail{#3}\fi}
\def\ProbeEqual#1#2#3{\ifx#1#2\else\ProbeFail{#3}\fi}
\def\ProbeField#1#2#3{%
  \expandafter\let\expandafter\ProbeActual\csname dte@e#1#2\endcsname
  \def\ProbeExpected{#3}\ProbeEqual\ProbeActual\ProbeExpected{field #1/#2}}
\def\ProbeRecord#1#2#3#4#5{%
  \ProbeField{#1}{d}{#2}\ProbeField{#1}{t}{#3}%
  \ProbeField{#1}{n}{#4}\ProbeField{#1}{c}{#5}}
\NewDocumentCommand\ProbeReadRaw{v}{\gdef\ProbeRaw{#1}}
\NewDocumentCommand\ProbeReadTab{v}{\gdef\ProbeTab{#1}}
\ProbeReadRaw|A_ B%$#&^~\{}|
\ProbeReadTab|A_ B	%$#&^~\{}|
\ExplSyntaxOn
\cs_new_protected:Npn \ProbeCats #1#2#3#4\ProbeStop
  {
    \token_if_letter:NTF #1 {} {\ProbeFail{verbatim~letter~category}}
    \token_if_other:NTF #2 {} {\ProbeFail{verbatim~underscore~category}}
    \token_if_active:NTF #3 {} {\ProbeFail{verbatim~space~category}}
  }
\cs_new_protected:Npn \ProbeTabCat #1#2#3#4#5#6\ProbeStop
  {\token_if_active:NTF #5 {} {\ProbeFail{verbatim~tab~category}}}
\ExplSyntaxOff
\def\ProbeRawField#1#2{%
  \expandafter\let\expandafter\ProbeActual\csname dte@e#1n\endcsname
  \ProbeEqual\ProbeActual#2{verbatim token identity at #1}%
  \expandafter\ProbeCats\ProbeActual\ProbeStop}
\def\ProbeExpectedError#1{%
  \edef\ProbeMessage{\string#1\space used outside dirtreex environment}%
  \edef\ProbeHelp{Every \string#1\space must appear inside the body of a dirtreex environment.}}
\def\ProbeColor{red}\def\ProbeStyle{solid}\def\ProbeWidth{2pt}\def\ProbeRadius{0pt}
\protected\def\ProbeProtectedRadius{0.3pt}
\def\ProbeNameText{P5NAME}\def\ProbeCommentText{P5COMMENT}\def\ProbeIconText{P5ICON}
\def\ProbeName{\global\advance\ProbeNameEffects by1\relax\ProbeNameText}
\def\ProbeComment{\global\advance\ProbeCommentEffects by1\relax\ProbeCommentText}
\def\ProbeIcon{\global\advance\ProbeIconEffects by1\relax\ProbeIconText}
\pgfkeys{/dte/entry/probe observe/.code={%
  \ProbeInt{\dte@cnt}{#1}{option callback count}%
  \ProbeInt{\currentgrouplevel}{\numexpr\ProbeCaptureLevel+1\relax}{extra capture group}%
  \expandafter\ifx\csname dte@e#1n\endcsname\relax\ProbeFail{name absent before options}\fi
  \expandafter\ifx\csname dte@e#1c\endcsname\relax\ProbeFail{comment absent before options}\fi
  \ProbeInt{\dte@eget{#1}{d}}{\dte@depth}{depth absent before options}%
  \ifnum\dte@eget{#1}{t}<0\ProbeFail{type absent before options}\fi
  \global\advance\ProbeObserved by1\relax}}
\let\ProbeOriginalPreprocess\dte@preprocess
\def\dte@preprocess{%
  \ifnum\dte@tnum=1\relax
    \ProbeInt{\dte@cnt}{7}{first tree count}%
    \ProbeRecord{1}{0}{1}{\ProbeName}{\ProbeComment}%
    \ProbeRecord{2}{1}{2}{archive.zip}{archive}%
    \ProbeRecord{5}{4}{0}{ordinary.txt}{ordinary}%
    \ProbeRawField{3}\ProbeRaw\ProbeRawField{4}\ProbeRaw
    \ProbeRawField{6}\ProbeRaw\ProbeRawField{7}\ProbeRaw
    \ProbeField{3}{d}{2}\ProbeField{3}{t}{1}%
    \ProbeField{4}{d}{3}\ProbeField{4}{t}{2}%
    \ProbeField{6}{d}{4}\ProbeField{6}{t}{0}%
    \ProbeField{7}{d}{0}\ProbeField{7}{t}{0}%
    \ProbeField{1}{lc}{blue}\ProbeField{1}{ls}{dashed}%
    \ProbeField{1}{lw}{1em}\ProbeField{1}{er}{0.7pt}%
    \ProbeField{1}{i}{\ProbeIcon}\ProbeField{2}{er}{\ProbeProtectedRadius}%
    \def\ProbeExpected{\ProbeColor}\ProbeEqual\dte@linecolor\ProbeExpected{environment color reference}%
    \def\ProbeExpected{\ProbeStyle}\ProbeEqual\dte@linestyle\ProbeExpected{environment style reference}%
    \ifdim\dte@rulewidth=\ProbeOuterEm\else\ProbeFail{environment width binding}\fi
    \ifdim\dte@elbowR=\ProbeOuterEm\else\ProbeFail{environment radius binding}\fi
    \ifdim\dimexpr\dte@eget{2}{er}\relax=0.3pt\else\ProbeFail{protected radius render meaning}\fi
    \ProbeInt{\ProbeNameEffects}{0}{name expanded during capture}%
    \ProbeInt{\ProbeCommentEffects}{0}{comment expanded during capture}%
    \ProbeInt{\ProbeIconEffects}{0}{icon expanded during capture}%
    \typeout{P5A FIRST-MODEL PASS; count=7; observed=\the\ProbeObserved}%
  \else
    \ProbeInt{\dte@tnum}{2}{unexpected tree}%
    \ProbeInt{\dte@cnt}{1}{sequential count}%
    \ProbeRecord{1}{0}{0}{P5SECOND}{ready}%
    \ProbeField{1}{i}{}\ProbeField{1}{lc}{}\ProbeField{1}{ls}{}%
    \ProbeField{1}{lw}{}\ProbeField{1}{er}{}%
    \expandafter\ifx\csname dte@e7n\endcsname\relax\else\ProbeFail{sequential stale field}\fi
    \typeout{P5A SEQUENTIAL-MODEL PASS; count=1}%
  \fi
  \ProbeOriginalPreprocess}
\let\ProbeOriginalFormat\DirtreexFormatName
\renewcommand\DirtreexFormatName[1]{%
  \global\advance\ProbeFormatted by1\relax
  \ifnum\dte@tnum=1\relax\ifnum#1=1\relax
    \ifdim\dimexpr\dte@eget{1}{lw}\relax=1em\else\ProbeFail{entry em render binding}\fi
    \ifdim\dimexpr\dte@eget{1}{lw}\relax=\ProbeOuterEm\ProbeFail{entry em frozen at capture}\fi
    \def\ProbeExpected{P5NAME}\ProbeEqual\ProbeNameText\ProbeExpected{name capture-local definition leaked}%
    \def\ProbeExpected{P5COMMENT}\ProbeEqual\ProbeCommentText\ProbeExpected{comment capture-local definition leaked}%
    \def\ProbeExpected{P5ICON}\ProbeEqual\ProbeIconText\ProbeExpected{icon capture-local definition leaked}%
  \fi\fi
  \ProbeOriginalFormat{#1}}
\makeatother
\begin{document}
\makeatletter
\begingroup
  \def\PackageError#1#2#3{%
    \def\ProbeActual{#1}\def\ProbeExpected{dirtreex}%
    \ProbeEqual\ProbeActual\ProbeExpected{error package}%
    \edef\ProbeActual{#2}\ProbeEqual\ProbeActual\ProbeMessage{specific error text}%
    \edef\ProbeActual{#3}\ProbeEqual\ProbeActual\ProbeHelp{specific help text}%
    \ProbeInt{\dte@cnt}{\ProbeErrors}{diagnostic before increment}%
    \global\advance\ProbeErrors by1\relax
    \typeout{P5A ERROR \the\ProbeErrors: \ProbeActual}}
  \ProbeExpectedError\dir\dir{outside-dir}{outside}{}
  \ProbeRecord{1}{0}{1}{outside-dir}{outside}
  \ProbeExpectedError\file\file{outside-file}{outside}
  \ProbeRecord{2}{0}{0}{outside-file}{outside}
  \ProbeExpectedError\archive\archive{outside-archive}{outside}{}
  \ProbeRecord{3}{0}{2}{outside-archive}{outside}
  \ProbeExpectedError\verbdir\verbdir|A_ B	%$#&^~\{}|{outside}{}
  \ProbeRawField{4}\ProbeTab
  \expandafter\ProbeTabCat\ProbeActual\ProbeStop
  \ProbeExpectedError\verbfile\verbfile{A_ B%$#&^~\{}}{outside}
  \ProbeRawField{5}\ProbeRaw
  \ProbeExpectedError\verbarchive\verbarchive|A_ B%$#&^~\{}|{outside}{}
  \ProbeRawField{6}\ProbeRaw
  \ProbeInt{\dte@cnt}{6}{post-error capture count}
  \ProbeField{4}{t}{1}\ProbeField{5}{t}{0}\ProbeField{6}{t}{2}
\endgroup
\ProbeInt{\ProbeErrors}{6}{all diagnostics}
\ProbeInt{\dte@cnt}{6}{global error continuation count}
\ProbeField{1}{n}{outside-dir}\ProbeRawField{4}\ProbeTab
\ProbeOuterEm=1em\relax
\noindent P5FIRST\par
\begin{dirtreex}[box=false,pagebreak=false,fontsize=\footnotesize,
  line color=\ProbeColor,line style=\ProbeStyle,line width=1em,elbow radius=1em]
  \def\ProbeColor{blue}\def\ProbeStyle{dashed}\def\ProbeWidth{1em}\def\ProbeRadius{0.7pt}
  \def\ProbeNameText{capture-name}\def\ProbeCommentText{capture-comment}\def\ProbeIconText{capture-icon}
  \ProbeCaptureLevel=\currentgrouplevel
  \dir[probe observe=1,line color=\ProbeColor,line style=\ProbeStyle,
       line width=\ProbeWidth,elbow radius=\ProbeRadius,icon={\ProbeIcon}]{\ProbeName}{\ProbeComment}

  {
    \protected\def\ProbeProtectedRadius{2pt}
    \ProbeCaptureLevel=\currentgrouplevel
    \archive[probe observe=2,elbow radius=\ProbeProtectedRadius]{archive.zip}{archive}

    {
      \ProbeCaptureLevel=\currentgrouplevel
      \verbdir[probe observe=3]|A_ B%$#&^~\{}|{delimited}

      {
        \ProbeCaptureLevel=\currentgrouplevel
        \verbarchive[probe observe=4]{A_ B%$#&^~\{}}{braced}

        {
          \ProbeCaptureLevel=\currentgrouplevel
          \file[probe observe=5]{ordinary.txt}{ordinary}
          \ProbeCaptureLevel=\currentgrouplevel
          \verbfile[probe observe=6]{A_ B%$#&^~\{}}{braced leaf}
        }
      }
    }
  }
  \ProbeCaptureLevel=\currentgrouplevel
  \verbfile[probe observe=7]|A_ B%$#&^~\{}|{delimited leaf}
\end{dirtreex}
\ProbeInt{\ProbeFormatted}{7}{first tree format once}
\ProbeInt{\ProbeObserved}{7}{all option callbacks}
\ProbeInt{\ProbeNameEffects}{1}{name once}
\ProbeInt{\ProbeCommentEffects}{1}{comment once}
\ProbeInt{\ProbeIconEffects}{1}{icon once}
\begin{dirtreex}[pagebreak=false]
  \file{P5SECOND}{ready}
\end{dirtreex}
\ProbeInt{\ProbeFormatted}{8}{sequential format once}
\ProbeInt{\dte@depth}{0}{depth restored}
\typeout{P5A CONTRACTS PASS; errors=6; callbacks=7; formatted=8; name/comment/icon=1/1/1}
\makeatother
\noindent P5DONE
\end{document}
